row.body: The keyring is wrapped in the lunchbox's cloth lining. A chalk boundary crosses the lid; the ring is on the clean side and the meal on the dusty one.
row.title: The keys stayed outside the marked floor

sidecar.gloss: A boundary separates the keys from the meal they travelled with.
sidecar.rival_reading: A warehouse crew could separate access keys from stored supplies during a routine safety check; the chalk line may have nothing to do with evacuation.

row.body: green crop residue marks the short rope; a scraped warning stripe marks the water bottle. both are tied with the same cord.
row.title: two traces on the short rope

sidecar.gloss: Farm residue and response markings share one deliberately ambiguous bundle.
sidecar.rival_reading: The farm program and the emergency response each explain one layer of the bundle, and the shared knot does not establish which purpose came first.

row.body: The notebook rests across the bucket. Its page labels two strips “control — standing” and “trial spray — curled by noon.” The next line reads “mix still active after valve shut.”
row.title: The trial strip curled after spraying

sidecar.gloss: A trial mixture remained active after application and damaged the test strip.
sidecar.rival_reading: A farm worker could record ordinary crop damage and a poorly shut valve; the notes do not establish an experimental program.
